_help: Edit the four model names, then run: node tools/set-models.mjs. Planning agents (strongest) decide quality — give them your best model. The reviewer must be a DIFFERENT model (ideally another family) from the coder's, or it shares the coder's blind spots; set-models warns if not.
_note: Checked against the OpenCode Go list on 22 Oct 2026 (deepseek-v4-flash is no longer listed). Each Go model has its own monthly limit: builders on V4.1 Flash, few planning calls on V4 Pro, reviewer on GLM-5.2 (another family). Confirm IDs with /models. Avoid the 'Contributor' models for client code (prompts may be used for training).
